feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 August 2026 5:45am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 03 August 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near Greenland, with low pressure southwest of Ireland, tracking northeast.


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in places at first, veering east or southeast 3 or 4 this afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate in places at first.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, becoming more persistent and heavier this evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or Southeast 4 or 5, veering south or southwest 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, veering west 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain at first, possibly heavy in places, soon clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.
